seal.statement: In the failing formation traced in the second causal packet of 2026-09-19, a joiner's planning owner serves a deferred readiness snapshot of the seed for 173 s - every dimension false, the previous reasons inherited, the old observedAt carried over - and routing denies on it without regard to its age. Which condition keeps a new build from being admitted cannot be observed: every term of the planning owner's reuse decision and every refusal of its publish decision is silent, and the routing denial does not say how old the record it trusted is or that it was deferred. This quest makes those observable without changing them; it is the verified part of the superseded quest readiness-admission-freeze-observed, whose error-cause clause is carried separately. The planning owner logs, per owner key, build variant and participation kind, each transition between serving an admitted record and serving a deferred one and each change of the failing terms while deferred, naming the terms of the reuse decision that failed from the one evaluation that decided, the age of the record whose verdict is being inherited, and on return to an admitted record the time spent deferred; a refused publish is logged with its refusal reason under the same once-per-change rule, and the return to a published state states how many refusals were suppressed and for how long publishes were refused. The routing denial line states, for each denied candidate it already lists, the age of the readiness record the denial was made on and whether that record was deferred. No decision, schedule, retry cadence, error, log message text or existing log field changes.

text: Successor A of the superseded readiness-admission-freeze-observed, carrying the verified recorder and routing-line surfaces and nothing of the error cause. The planning owner records, per owner key x build-options-key variant x participation kind, each transition between serving an admitted record and serving a deferred one and each change of the failing terms while deferred (src/control-plane/readiness-admission-transition-record.js, plus the owner's own call sites in readiness-planning-completion-admission-methods.js and readiness-planning-snapshot-owner.js); the deferred-snapshot predicate moved to its marker's owner (readiness-planning-version-contract.js, consumed by control-plane-mutation-readiness.js); the age of a readiness observation is stated by the module that owns observedAt (resolveReadinessObservedAgeMs in eligibility-snapshot.js); and the routing denial line carries observedAgeMs and deferred per denied candidate, with the age read once per emitted line rather than once per denied node per snapshot (query-executor-partition-routing-snapshot.js, query-executor-partition-service-resolution.js, and two re-exports in query-executor-shared.js). Every source file was taken as the exact blob verified in refs/lagrange-scratch/freeze-observed-r4 except query-executor-shared.js, where only the two re-export hunks were taken and the participant-failure-entry hunk was left. Nothing about routingDenialCause is present: no failure-result field, no carrier site, no readRoutingDenialCause or attachRoutingDenialCause, no heartbeat field, no admin site, no census, no engine projection. The four frozen oracles were re-measured on a git archive of current main 902714be8 and all four are unchanged.

MEASURED: the complexity baseline is NOT tightened by this successor, because the superseded tree's one reduction belongs entirely to the error-cause work that successor B carries. Three runs of the repository's own checker: pristine main 902714be8 measures 1816/1816; main plus THIS quest's source set measures 1816/1816; main plus the superseded tree's FULL source set (kept plus dropped hunks) measures 1815/1816 and prints 'Baseline can be tightened from 1816 to 1815'. Diffing the violation lists of the first and third runs names the one function that crosses back under the threshold: deliverTransactionOperation in src/query/sql-query-engine.js, 14 on main, which fell below 13 when the four transaction throws were routed through a local fail(message) helper - a cause-carrying change this successor does not take. Diffing the violation lists of the first and second runs shows the two sets are identical function for function, with only line numbers shifted, so this quest's kept set is exactly complexity-neutral: it adds no violation and removes none. scripts/check-complexity.js is therefore left untouched at main's 1816. Successor B should expect to tighten it to 1815 when it lands the cause work.
